findings.message: This fixes the named defect: hr2 no longer describes the 'Start onboarding' flow, which the product doesn't have, and certification reminders are a shipped feature (learning's remind_certification and the Remind chip). But the rewritten card makes a new claim the product doesn't back, which breaks AC-6 ('claims still match the product'). The card says 'Certification recorded by Liam Walsh'. Recording a certification needs `learning:certification:record`, and modules/learning/module.ts:23 grants that to HR only (README:13). This same queue presents Liam Walsh as an Engineer (en1 'Accepted by you, Liam Walsh'), so he can't record his own certificate. Fix: credit the recording to an HR person (e.g. 'Recorded in learning by <HR name>'). Before marking AC-6 met, check that the card's other fields (holder, actor, action) can each be done by the role the card names.
findings.scenario: Liam Walsh (Engineer role) calls record_certification → the service refuses: the Engineer role lacks learning:certification:record. The card shows him doing exactly that.
